answer.rationale: The incumbent has refused to reopen price and the primary contract lapses in 14 days with no auto-renew, so renew, renegotiate, or defer cannot both hit the 18% spend cut and keep supply in force. The low-cost quote meets the mandate alone; memory_c2 reports a prior primary move to that vendor cut unit cost with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, making switch the only single action that replaces the expiring contract and lowers TCO. memory_c1 and the 94% line with no buffer imply cutover can raise delivery risk, so that downstream risk is flagged and c2 must be verified before treating last year’s ‘quick’ onboarding as fit for a 14-day, no-buffer window. Uncertainty on current-year cutover time remains.
